verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships 'Fivetran Alerts' in its dashboard and an official MCP server that lets you ask 'when was the last time my connection completed a sync?' and 'are any of my connections broken?', which directly maps to freshness/cadence monitoring and alerting on missed syncs. However, docs give only a title-level description of alerts with no detail on configuring freshness/SLA thresholds, and community reports (e.g., syncs getting out of sync every couple of months) suggest cadence issues occur in practice even if alerting exists. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring freshness/staleness thresholds or SLA-based alert rules, and independent confirmation that alerts reliably catch missed-cadence incidents.
